latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release supporting the end-to-end launch and scaling of coaching businesses.

- Guides coaches through niche selection, positioning, ICP/avatar definition, package/pricing strategy, sales, lead generation, fulfillment, certification, and scaling.
- Includes a diagnostic sweep to identify stage, niche, numbers, sales process, credibility, goals, and constraints before recommendations.
- Covers common coaching business models: 1:1, group/cohort, hybrid, mastermind, and digital product transitions.
- Addresses burnout, retention, client results tracking, and energy management for sustainable growth.
- Refuses support for unethical or deceptive coaching models and directs users to evidence-based practices only.
